page.layout: One column of alphabetical index entries (words under the letter I, then words beginning "ma" and "me"), each followed by page references running to the right, cut off at the right edge of the scan.; One column of index entries, with a narrow strip of page numbers at the far left that belongs to the cut-off left column. Headword at the left, page references at the right. Running head "N D E X." across the top. No page number, catchword or signature visible.
page.notes: Doubtful readings: "maritare, marijus" (final letters blurred), "masticbe" (printed form uncertain). Numbers at the right edge of several lines are cut off and are given only as far as visible. Long s is normalised to s. A few small smudges near the top and bottom of the scan are not printed text and are omitted. The first letter of the running head is cut off, so it is read as "N D E X." The left strip of page numbers belongs to a column that is cut off, so those numbers are kept at the start of their lines. The wrapped figures (857, 860, 846, 858, 738 and similar) were printed on the line below the entry and are joined to it here. The last headword is cut off at the lower edge and is read as "mercede" with a doubt mark. Some left-edge numbers could not be matched with certainty to their entries.
